description: Template and field guide for a Joint Works Agreement. Used when multiple water licence holders jointly construct and manage shared water infrastructure. Defines all required sections, fields, and their expected values.
global_summary: A Joint Works Agreement is a structured legal contract between multiple water licence holders or land occupants who jointly construct and manage shared water infrastructure. It defines the parties involved, their water rights, cost-sharing percentages, operational responsibilities, governance through a manager, usage restrictions, land access rights, dispute resolution mechanisms, and legal continuity. It ensures coordinated development and maintenance of shared water systems while preventing misuse and defining enforceable obligations for all parties.
